entries: Added red, blue and custom guiding-rope colors via PbzModConfig.
在PbzModConfig中新增红色、蓝色和自定义导航绳子颜色。
Fixed the custom-color preview remaining visible when a preset is selected.
修复选择预设颜色后自定义颜色预览仍然残留的问题。
Choose red, blue or a custom guiding-rope color in PbzModConfig.
在PbzModConfig中选择红色、蓝色或自定义导航绳子颜色。
Improved stair, multi-floor and climbing navigation.
改善楼梯、上下层和攀爬前后的路线衔接。
Adjusted route calculation to reduce unnecessary waiting.
调整路线计算，减少不必要的等待。
Fixed D-pad collectible selection and markers on combined maps.
修复十字键选物和合并地图标记问题。
Improved route display near walls; added D-pad item selection and A confirmation.
改善墙边的路线显示，新增十字键选物与A键确认。
Improved bell selection and detours around blocked routes.
改善铃铛识别和受阻路线绕行。
Added navigation support for more traversal actions and kept targets while sailing.
增加更多移动方式的导航支持，乘船时保留导航目标。
Improved walking routes, bell transfers, sliding and rope-descent guidance.
改善步行路线、铃铛中转、下滑和沿绳下降导航。
Added route-calculation and map-loading messages with elapsed time.
增加路线计算、地图加载提示和等待秒数。
Improved bell transfers and compatibility with Map Tracker.
改善铃铛中转及与Map Tracker的兼容性。
Added Chinese acquisition hints for more items.
补充更多物品的中文获取提示。
